task.news: Nela moved the radio programme from Tuesday to Wednesday. The broadcast time, duration and reception are unchanged.
task.expressive: A little change in the weekly rhythm! Update the listing so everyone finds the programme on Wednesday.

task.user: Nela moved the radio programme from Tuesday to Wednesday. The broadcast time, duration and reception are unchanged. Respond to this update and suggest one practical next step. Use two sentences. Keep the response factual and emotionally restrained.

response: The radio programme has been rescheduled from Tuesday to Wednesday, with no changes to its broadcast time, duration, or reception. A practical next step would be to update all relevant schedules and promotional materials to reflect the new broadcast day.
